definitions.explanation: Almost touching; very close to something; by a narrow margin.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}にすれすれで{間|ま}に{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I just barely made the train.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}をすれすれでかわした。
examples.english: I barely dodged it by a hair.

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}{点|てん}すれすれで{受|う}かった。
examples.english: I passed with barely a passing score.

notes: Describes narrowly avoiding or achieving something; being on the edge. Often used with で (by the margin of) or when describing close calls. Derived from {擦|す}れる (to rub against).
